Format your response as JSON with the following structure:

{{
  "analysis": "Analyze the current state based on the terminal output provided. What do you see? What has been accomplished? What still needs to be done?",
  "plan": "Describe your plan for the next steps. What commands will you run and why? Be specific about what you expect each command to accomplish.",

    {{
      "keystrokes": "ls -la\\n",
      "duration": 0.1

      "keystrokes": "cd project\\n",
      "duration": 0.1
    }}
  ],
  "task_complete": true
}}

Required fields:
- "analysis": Your analysis of the current situation
- "plan": Your plan for the next steps
- "commands": Array of command objects to execute

Optional fields:
- "task_complete": Boolean indicating if the task is complete (defaults to false if not present)

Command object structure:
- "keystrokes": String containing the exact keystrokes to send to the terminal (required)
- "duration": Number of seconds to wait for the command to complete (defaults to 1.0 if not present)

IMPORTANT: The text inside "keystrokes" will be used as shell commands.
- Most bash commands should end with a newline (\n) to cause them to execute
- For special key sequences, use: C-c for Ctrl+C, C-d for Ctrl+D

The "duration" attribute specifies wait time:
- 0.1 seconds for instant commands (cd, ls, echo, cat)
- 1.0 seconds for normal commands (gcc, find, rustc)
- 5-30 seconds for slow commands (make, python scripts, wget)

Important notes:
- Each command's keystrokes are executed in sequence
- Do not include extra whitespace unless it's part of the command
- The JSON must be valid - use proper escaping for quotes
- Commands array can be empty if you want to wait without taking action
- Set task_complete to true ONLY when the task is fully finished and verified
- CRITICAL: BEFORE writing any code or modifying files, you MUST explore the workspace and read the provided documentation (e.g., `cat skill.md` or `cat task_spec.json`) to learn the required skills and constraints.
- DO NOT rely solely on your pre-trained knowledge. Base your implementation strictly on the context provided in the workspace documents.

# Northstar Studio

## The Next Generation Creative Platform

Welcome to **Northstar Studio** — where creativity meets precision. Our powerful, intuitive platform empowers designers, developers, and creators to bring their boldest visions to life.

---

### 🚀 What is Northstar Studio?

Northstar Studio is a comprehensive creative workspace designed for modern teams. Whether you're crafting stunning visuals, building immersive experiences, or prototyping next-generation applications, Northstar Studio provides the tools you need to succeed.

**Launch Identifier:** NORTHSTAR-LAUNCH-2025

---

### ✨ Key Features

- **Real-time Collaboration** — Work together seamlessly with your team, no matter where they are
- **Intelligent Design System** — AI-powered suggestions that adapt to your workflow
- **Cross-Platform Export** — Publish to web, mobile, and desktop from a single project
- **Component Library** — Thousands of pre-built, customizable components
- **Version Control** — Built-in Git integration for complete project history
- **Performance Analytics** — Track engagement and optimize user experiences

---

### 📦 Installation

```bash
# Using npm
npm install @northstar/studio

# Using yarn
yarn add @northstar/studio

# Using pip
pip install northstar-studio
```

---

### 🎯 Quick Start

```javascript
import { Studio } from '@northstar/studio';

const project = new Studio.Project({
  name: 'My First Project',
  theme: 'modern'
});

project.create();
project.publish();
```

---

### 📚 Documentation

- [Getting Started Guide](https://docs.northstar.studio/getting-started)
- [API Reference](https://docs.northstar.studio/api)
- [Component Library](https://docs.northstar.studio/components)
- [Tutorials](https://docs.northstar.studio/tutorials)

---

### 🤝 Community & Support

- **Discord:** Join our community at discord.gg/northstar
- **Twitter:** Follow us @NorthstarStudio
- **GitHub:** Report issues or contribute
- **Email:** support@northstar.studio

---

### 📄 License

Northstar Studio is released under the MIT License. See [LICENSE](LICENSE) for details.

---

**Built with passion by the Northstar Team**

# Northstar Studio Release Notes

## Version 1.0.0 — Official Launch

**Release Date:** April 2025  
**Build:** 2025.4.1  
**Release Type:** Major Release

---

### 🎉 Launch Edition: NORTHSTAR-LAUNCH-2025

We're thrilled to announce the official launch of Northstar Studio! After months of development and beta testing, we're ready to share our vision with the world.

---

## 🆕 New Features

### Core Platform
- **Project Workspace** — Organize and manage multiple projects with ease
- **Smart Canvas** — Intelligent design surface that adapts to your content
- **Component Inspector** — Deep dive into any component with full property control
- **Live Preview** — See changes in real-time across all devices

### Collaboration Tools
- **Multi-User Editing** — Multiple team members can work simultaneously
- **Comment System** — Leave feedback directly on designs
- **Change Tracking** — See exactly what changed and by whom
- **Approval Workflow** — Streamlined review and approval processes

### Export & Integration
- **Universal Export** — Export to 20+ formats including React, Vue, Swift, and more
- **API Access** — Full REST and GraphQL APIs for custom integrations
- **CI/CD Integration** — Connect with GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, and more
- **Design Token Sync** — Keep your design system in sync across platforms

---

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Fixed issue with component nesting on complex layouts
- Resolved memory leak in preview mode during long sessions
- Fixed color picker accuracy for certain color profiles
- Corrected export formatting for RTL languages
- Improved handling of large asset libraries

---

## ⚡ Performance Improvements

- 40% faster project load times
- 60% reduction in memory usage
- Optimized rendering pipeline for 120fps preview
- Improved asset compression algorithms
- Enhanced caching strategies for frequently used components

---

## 🔧 Technical Updates

- Updated to Node.js 20 LTS compatibility
- Added support for WebGPU acceleration
- Implemented new state management system
- Upgraded TypeScript definitions
- Added comprehensive error boundaries

---

## 📋 Known Issues

- Safari 14.x: Some advanced animations may not render correctly
- Linux: First-time setup may require additional dependencies
- Large projects (>1000 components): Initial load may take longer than expected

---

## 🙏 Acknowledgments

Thank you to our amazing beta testers, community contributors, and everyone who helped make Northstar Studio a reality. Your feedback shaped every feature in this release.

---

## 🔗 Resources

- [Installation Guide](https://docs.northstar.studio/install)
- [Migration Guide](https://docs.northstar.studio/migration)
- [Changelog](https://github.com/northstar/studio/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
- [Support Portal](https://support.northstar.studio)

---
